title: Mixed Event — As the Leaves Change Once More — Episode7 A Leaf-Viewing Reattempt

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More
meta.Event Outline: After the success at Jam Fest, Shiho is energized to practice. But Shizuku and Saki invite her on a day trip to relax and enjoy the fall foliage.

rows.Line: Mountain

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We've climbed quite far now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Based on this map, the best spot for viewing leaves should be just up ahead...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
There's the observation deck!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's reattempt time!
We've gotta take as many pictures as we can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's try getting closer!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no need to rush. It's not like the leaves are going anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? I thought I felt a raindrop just now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I felt one as well. Is a raincloud passing over us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, but the forecast said it wouldn't rain!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nothing for it. We need to hurry and see the leaves before it really starts coming down...!
se_run_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, here it comes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What terrible timing...
Did you all bring umbrellas?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we both brought compact umbrellas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That includes you, Saki.
You'll catch a cold if you don't stay dry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
But we were so close... It was sunny, and the leaves were right there...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We failed our mission...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Right. Up here in the mountains, the weather can change in an instant...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The goal of this trip was to go leaf-viewing, so we probably should've done this first.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then we would've been able to see the leaves like we wanted...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's my fault for not scheduling this activity first.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It may be raining now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But this is also really nice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't know if it's because the rain made them wet, but these leaves seem much more vibrant compared to when the sun was out just now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I remember feeling so sad when it rained like this when we were children, but I think I'm really enjoying leaf-viewing in this weather.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm inclined to agree with Shizuku here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just as the leaves appear one way when it's sunny, they'll look completely different when it's rainy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Tsukasa, there's a leaf stuck to your umbrella...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like it's a part of my umbrella's design now! This wouldn't have happened if it were still sunny.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We must be very blessed, getting to experience so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really am nothing like these three.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm always worrying about not wasting time and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even for this trip, I obsessed over coming up with the most efficient itinerary...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I immediately thought it fell apart the second something unexpected happened.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But they don't care about any of that.
Instead, they're...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The answer to that is simple! A physical ticket adds to the sentimental value of this trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I know I'm gonna pick the most delicious grapes in this vineyard!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Doesn't this look like a piece of art?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're able to fully enjoy what's right in front of them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They cherish every second of every moment.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Sure, that leads to us taking a lot of detours and having to clean up extra messes...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But when I'm with them, I'm able to see the benefits of all the things that I refused to consider...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (At least, that's what I feel.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad we came here today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially since we got to see such a beautiful view.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank goodness!
I'm so glad to hear that you're having fun, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm also glad.
I was honestly a little worried, since you almost literally carried this entire trip on your back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I sure did, and don't you forget it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oof...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm only teasing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look, it's starting to clear up a little!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Sunbeams are beginning to poke through the clouds...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The leaves... They're sparkling so much...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, very...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The contrast between these leaves and the sunset... What a stunning view!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. On top of seeing the leaves when it rained, we got to see them as the sky cleared back up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is all thanks to the plan you made for us, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, we can't thank you enough!
This place has been an absolute feast for our eyes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Thanks for putting so much thought into this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, this is all just a big coincidence.
To be frank, things didn't actually go according to plan.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I am glad to see them all smiling like this...)
